ui.common.viewer.close.role: accessible name and tooltip of the lightbox's close control
ui.common.viewer.close.tone: short verb phrase with its object, sentence case
ui.common.viewer.close.note: `kind` selects the item: image or asset. Keep every arm; each arm is a complete sentence, so word order and articles may change.

ui.common.viewer.next.role: accessible name and tooltip of the lightbox's next control
ui.common.viewer.next.tone: short verb phrase with its object, sentence case
ui.common.viewer.next.note: `kind` selects the item: image or asset. Keep every arm; each arm is a complete sentence, so word order and articles may change.

ui.common.viewer.opening.role: placeholder title in an image or video viewer while its bytes are still being resolved
ui.common.viewer.opening.tone: present-participle progress phrase, sentence case, trailing ellipsis kept
ui.common.viewer.opening.note: One key shared by the canvas image preview, the canvas video preview and both of their resolution routes, because they show the same wait at the same step. The ellipsis is shipped copy; do not add a second one in JSX.

ui.common.viewer.position.role: position line inside an image or asset carousel
ui.common.viewer.position.tone: noun phrase with two numbers, sentence case
ui.common.viewer.position.note: `index` is the one-based position and `count` the size of the set. An allowed exception, not a plural: the two numbers are rendered by the app's number rules. `kind` selects the item: image or asset. Keep every arm; each arm is a complete sentence, so word order and articles may change.

placeholders.count: how many items the set holds.

ui.common.viewer.previous.role: accessible name and tooltip of the lightbox's previous control
ui.common.viewer.previous.tone: short verb phrase with its object, sentence case
ui.common.viewer.previous.note: `kind` selects the item: image or asset. Keep every arm; each arm is a complete sentence, so word order and articles may change.

ui.common.viewer.reset_view.role: image lightbox control that returns zoom and pan to fit and centred; used as both accessible name and tooltip
ui.common.viewer.reset_view.tone: verb phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.common.viewer.reset_view.note: One key for the button's aria-label and its title, which must never disagree. Disabled when the view is already fit and centred.

ui.common.viewer.zoom_in.role: image lightbox control that steps the picture one level up the zoom ladder; used as both accessible name and tooltip
ui.common.viewer.zoom_in.tone: verb phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.common.viewer.zoom_in.note: One key for aria-label and title. Disabled at the top of the ladder and while the picture is not panning-capable.

ui.common.viewer.zoom_out.role: image lightbox control that steps the picture one level down the zoom ladder; used as both accessible name and tooltip
ui.common.viewer.zoom_out.tone: verb phrase, sentence case, no trailing punctuation
ui.common.viewer.zoom_out.note: One key for aria-label and title. Disabled at fit and below, so the pair with Zoom in stays legible side by side.

ui.common.viewer.image_lightbox.previous.tone: Plain, concise product language; preserve the original meaning and technical tokens.
ui.common.viewer.image_lightbox.previous.note: Shown in image-lightbox.tsx; accessible label in the image lightbox surface.

placeholders.medialabel: Dynamic value supplied by the product; retain verbatim unless it is a user-facing number already formatted by the caller.

ui.common.viewer.image_lightbox.next.tone: Plain, concise product language; preserve the original meaning and technical tokens.

placeholders.medialabel: Dynamic value supplied by the product; retain verbatim unless it is a user-facing number already formatted by the caller.

ui.common.viewer.image_lightbox.close.tone: Plain, concise product language; preserve the original meaning and technical tokens.
ui.common.viewer.image_lightbox.close.note: Shown in image-lightbox.tsx; accessible label in the image lightbox surface.

placeholders.medialabel: Dynamic value supplied by the product; retain verbatim unless it is a user-facing number already formatted by the caller.

ui.common.viewer.image_lightbox.asset_of.tone: Plain, concise product language; preserve meaning and technical tokens.
ui.common.viewer.image_lightbox.asset_of.note: Complete ICU message for the viewer surface; dynamic values are composed without English fragment concatenation.

placeholders.index: Dynamic value supplied by the product; numeric counts select native plural categories and retain their existing display formatting.
placeholders.count: Dynamic value supplied by the product; numeric counts select native plural categories and retain their existing display formatting.

ui.common.viewer.image_progress.length: One toast, status line, settings row, or hub update sentence; keep compact.

placeholders.count: Numeric count; ICU plural selector and ungrouped number.
placeholders.index: Runtime value; preserve the placeholder and insert it without translation.
